translations.web: Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I myself have seen it,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
translations.asv: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it, saith Jehovah.
